verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say you can create your first agent with a single command, which points to a first-party command-line scaffolding entry point. The evidence never names the CLI, its commands, or any AI-native or agent-driven CLI workflow beyond initial project creation. missing for 10: a named official CLI with documented commands (dev, build, deploy), CLI usage for agent-driven or AI-native workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create your first agent with a single command and start building.
Add Mastra to an existing project, or create a new app with your preferred framework
